description: React component for a game screen that manages a timed target-clicking game with scoring, targets spawning/movement, and combo mechanics.

methods.name: dbg
methods.description: Debug helper function that logs messages to the console if available.

methods.name: GameScreen({ onFinish, prefersReducedMotion })
methods.description: Main React component rendering the game interface, handling game state, targets movement, scoring, and user interactions.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets game state variables to restart the game.

methods.name: spawnTarget
methods.description: Creates a new target with randomized position and velocity within the play area.

methods.name: removeTarget
methods.description: Handles target removal upon hit, updates score with potential combo multiplier, and schedules combo decay.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Animation loop handling target movement, spawning, and game timing until game ends.
